'''Walda Ceen''' was a [[Near-Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked for [[CreedCon Construction]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
When CreedCon began construction of a race track through the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], Ceen was part of a group of construction workers who were tasked with building a bridge for part of the race course. However, they uncovered a [[Cloud Mountain cavern|mysterious cavern]], which was home to an ancient creature, the [[t'salak]], that had been imprisoned there by the [[Tarasin]]. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] traveled there and tried to free the creature, but was unable to do so, so took out her anger by capturing all the workers at the bridge construction site, including Buume.<ref name="Force Concession" />

Muun took the captured workers to [[TX-38]], a deserted factory, located on [[Tilnes]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of Cularin. She managed to obtain the t'salak and it touched Ceen and the other workers with its tendrils, causing them all to enter a violent rage. However, they were eventually rescued by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].<ref name="Force Contention">{{LivingForce|Forces of Cularin: Force Contention}}</ref>
